vice.title: VICE LEGEND
vice.art: A neon penthouse tower over the night skyline with fireworks; the pink convertible is parked below.
vice.msg: Top floor, neon view, valet parked the car. You read Florida like a local.

veteran.title: FLORIDA VETERAN
veteran.art: Pastel Art Deco buildings on Ocean Drive at sunset, a beach umbrella on the sand and the convertible on the promenade.
veteran.msg: One wrong turn and still on the beach by sunset. Respect.

tourist.title: TOURIST WITH POTENTIAL
tourist.art: A retro roadside motel with a pink neon MOTEL sign and the convertible in the parking lot at dusk.
tourist.msg: The ice machine works, and so do your instincts. Mostly.

glades.title: LOST IN THE EVERGLADES
glades.art: The convertible sunk to its doors in a mangrove swamp while alligator eyes watch from the water.
glades.msg: The GPS gave up. The gators did not. Same road tomorrow?

fman.title: CERTIFIED FLORIDA MAN
fman.art: A broken-down smoking convertible with its hood up on the highway shoulder, with the gator mascot sitting beside it.
fman.msg: Car smoking, gator judging, and honestly? Iconic. Fresh road tomorrow.
